flags: Cache does not establish the formal scenic-byway designation or designation date; tourism-office framing retained without asserting a designation. Road-building history is limited to Berlin–Gorham, not the entire modern loop.
Strip mileage runs in the opposite direction from the tourism brochure. Overview and moments consistently follow the brochure’s Lancaster–Stark–Milan–Randolph loop.
Brochure describes working Groveton mills; cache 03 records Wausau production ending in 2008. Present operation omitted.
Stark bridge source disagrees internally on construction (1857/1862) and flood (1890/1895) dates; neither date used. Nansen present competition status is not established.
